title: The Glasshouse
intro: Your grandmother left you her garden, and a note: "Save the moon orchid."

garden.name: Overgrown garden
garden.description: Weeds have taken over the beds. A glasshouse glitters to the north. A shed leans to the east, a pond lies to the west, and an orchard rustles to the south.

north.message: The glasshouse door is locked. A small keyhole is rusty but intact.

shed.name: Garden shed
shed.description: Dusty shelves, clay pots and a smell of old soil. The garden is back to the west.

pond.name: Pond
pond.description: Still green water and lily pads. Something glints at the bottom, out of reach. The garden is to the east.

orchard.name: Orchard
orchard.description: Old apple trees in crooked rows. A fishing net hangs from a branch. The garden is to the north.

glasshouse.name: Glasshouse
glasshouse.description: Warm, damp air and dirty glass. On a table in the middle, a pale orchid droops in dry soil. The door to the south leads out.

note.name: a note
note.description: "The key is where the fish used to be. Water her, she gets thirsty. Love, Grandma."

full_can.name: a watering can full of pond water

net.name: a fishing net
net.description: A net on a long bamboo pole.

apple.name: an apple
apple.description: Red, a bit wrinkly, probably fine.

key.name: a brass key
key.description: Small, brass, still shiny under the mud.

actions.message: You sweep the net along the bottom of the pond and pull up a brass key!
You fill the watering can with pond water.
You water the orchid. The soil darkens, and slowly the stem straightens. A single white flower opens, glowing faintly like the moon.
You water the weeds. They look grateful. You'd better fill the can again.
Crunchy and sweet. You feel ready for anything.
